operations.description: Delete the repository identified by `name`
operations.T: [METHOD] delete [NAME] repository delete [PATH] acr [PARAMS] name [SCHEMA] deleted repository

operations.description: Delete tag
operations.T: [METHOD] delete [NAME] tag delete [PATH] acr tags [PARAMS] name reference [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Removes an already uploaded blob.
operations.T: [METHOD] delete [NAME] blob delete [PATH] blobs [PARAMS] digest name [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Delete the manifest identified by `name` and `reference`. Note that a manifest can _only_ be deleted by `digest`.
operations.T: [METHOD] delete [NAME] manifests delete [PATH] manifests [PARAMS] name reference [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Cancel outstanding upload processes, releasing associated resources. If this is not called, the unfinished uploads will eventually timeout.
operations.T: [METHOD] delete [NAME] blob cancel upload [PATH]  [PARAMS] blob link next uuid [SCHEMA]

operations.description: List repositories
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] repository list [PATH] acr catalog [PARAMS] last n [SCHEMA] repositories

operations.description: Get repository attributes
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] repository attributes [PATH] acr [PARAMS] name [SCHEMA] attributes changeable repository

operations.description: List manifests of a repository
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] manifests list [PATH] acr manifests [PARAMS] last n name orderby [SCHEMA] acr attributes base changeable manifest manifests

operations.description: Get manifest attributes
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] manifests attributes [PATH] acr manifests [PARAMS] name reference [SCHEMA] attributes base changeable manifest

operations.description: List tags of a repository
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] tag list [PATH] acr tags [PARAMS] digest last n name orderby [SCHEMA] attributes base changeable list tag

operations.description: Get tag attributes by tag
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] tag attributes [PATH] acr tags [PARAMS] name reference [SCHEMA] attributes base changeable tag

operations.description: Exchange Username, Password and Scope an ACR Access Token
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] access tokens from login [PATH] oauth 2 token [PARAMS] scope service [SCHEMA] access token

operations.description: Tells whether this Docker Registry instance supports Docker Registry HTTP API v2
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] support check [PATH]  [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Retrieve the blob from the registry identified by digest.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] blob [PATH] blobs [PARAMS] digest name [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Get the manifest identified by `name` and `reference` where `reference` can be a tag or digest.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] manifests [PATH] manifests [PARAMS] accept name reference [SCHEMA] annotations attributes descriptor fs history image jwk layer list manifest platform signature wrapper

operations.description: Retrieve status of upload identified by uuid. The primary purpose of this endpoint is to resolve the current status of a resumable upload.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] blob status [PATH]  [PARAMS] blob link next uuid [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Update the attribute identified by `name` where `reference` is the name of the repository.
operations.T: [METHOD] patch [NAME] repository update attributes [PATH] acr [PARAMS] name [SCHEMA] attributes changeable

operations.description: Update attributes of a manifest
operations.T: [METHOD] patch [NAME] manifests update attributes [PATH] acr manifests [PARAMS] name reference [SCHEMA] attributes changeable

operations.description: Update tag attributes
operations.T: [METHOD] patch [NAME] tag update attributes [PATH] acr tags [PARAMS] name reference [SCHEMA] attributes changeable

operations.description: Upload a stream of data without completing the upload.
operations.T: [METHOD] patch [NAME] blob upload [PATH]  [PARAMS] blob link next uuid [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Exchange AAD tokens for an ACR refresh Token
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] refresh tokens from exchange [PATH] oauth 2 exchange [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] refresh token

operations.description: Exchange ACR Refresh token for an ACR Access Token
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] access tokens [PATH] oauth 2 token [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] access token

operations.description: Mount a blob identified by the `mount` parameter from another repository.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] blob mount [PATH] blobs uploads [PARAMS] from mount name [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Put the manifest identified by `name` and `reference` where `reference` can be a tag or digest.
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME] manifests create [PATH] manifests [PARAMS] name reference [SCHEMA] manifest

operations.description: Complete the upload, providing all the data in the body, if necessary. A request without a body will just complete the upload with previously uploaded content.
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME] blob end upload [PATH]  [PARAMS] blob digest link next uuid [SCHEMA]
